info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Banking It Management Systems Assurance By Systems Assurance Id-v5-spec
info.description: This API allows users to access detailed Banking IT Management Systems Assurance records by their unique identifier. It serves financial institutions and IT managers to retrieve assurance documentation and insights critical for compliance and risk management. By leveraging this endpoint, users can ensure that their systems are validated and align with industry standards. Typical consumers include banking IT teams and compliance officers looking to verify assurance claims associated with their systems.
